label: Pyruvate, TCA intermediates and carboxylate transport
reason: Pyruvate oxidation, TCA/malate-aspartate shuttle and di/tricarboxylate transporters form one central carbon metabolism theme; Salla disease is a minor odd member.

label: Epithelial cell junctions, adhesion and polarity
reason: Adherens junctions, desmosomes/hemidesmosomes, cadherin adhesion, apical-basal polarity and EMT form one junction theme; cardiac AP and indole-3-methanol are minor odd members.

label: Glycan biosynthesis, glycosylation and glycan catabolism
reason: N/O-glycosylation, sugar-nucleotide synthesis/transport, sialylation/fucosylation, GPI, glycosphingolipids, CDGs and lysosomal glycan breakdown all concern glycoconjugate metabolism; a few odd members (paranodal junction, chitin).

label: Antimicrobial peptides and defensins
reason: Defensins, metal sequestration, bacterial killing and mucosal innate defence are one antimicrobial effector theme.

label: RNA Pol II initiation, pausing and elongation
reason: Pol II pre-initiation, promoter escape, pausing, P-TEFb elongation and capping, including HIV Tat-dependent transcription, form one transcription-cycle theme.

label: Cytokine receptor JAK-STAT5 signalling
reason: IL-2/3/5/7/9, EPO, TPO and FLT3 (including oncogenic fusions) all signal via JAK/STAT5 and SHC/PI3K/RAS; RUNX1-BCR is a lone odd member.

label: TLR2/4 LPS sensing in monocytes
reason: LPS/lipopeptide detection, CD14/LBP, TLR2/4 regulation, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiency and monocyte modules form one innate TLR theme; heme signaling fits as an endogenous TLR4 ligand.

label: Neutrophil and monocyte chemotaxis, chemokines
reason: Granulocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, chemokine production, formyl peptide and complement receptor signalling are one myeloid recruitment theme.

label: Pre-mRNA splicing, 3' processing and export
reason: Spliceosome assembly, snRNA/snRNP biogenesis, polyadenylation, histone mRNA processing and mRNA nuclear export form one mRNA maturation theme.

label: Renal water/sodium balance, vasopressin and RAAS
reason: Vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption, renin-angiotensin, natriuresis and blood pressure regulation form one fluid-homeostasis theme; the neuronal cAMP module is a minor misfit.

label: B and T lymphocyte activation and development
reason: BCR/TCR signalling, costimulation, thymic selection, B cell differentiation and lymphocyte BTMs form one adaptive lymphocyte activation theme.

label: Eicosanoid synthesis and signalling
reason: PLA2-arachidonate release, COX prostaglandins/thromboxanes, leukotrienes, PAF and their receptors form one eicosanoid lipid-mediator theme.

label: MHC class II antigen presentation by DCs
reason: MHC-II peptide loading, regulation of antigen presentation and dendritic/APC surface signatures are one antigen presentation theme; exosome assembly and BTN are minor.

label: Antiviral innate sensing and type I IFN
reason: RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS/TLR3-TBK1-IRF3/7, ISG15 and interferon-alpha response modules form one antiviral type I IFN theme.

label: Mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis
reason: BH3-only activation, BAX/BAK MOMP, cytochrome c release, apoptosome/caspases, SMAC-IAP and p53 apoptotic targets are one intrinsic apoptosis theme.

label: Protein quality control and selective autophagy
reason: Misfolded protein response, aggresome/aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy, ERAD regulation and organelle-selective autophagy form one proteostasis theme.

label: Reproductive organ and pancreatic endocrine development
reason: Gonad/sex determination and reproductive tract/prostate development sit with pancreatic progenitor and endocrine lineage terms without a specific shared mechanism.

label: Adherens junctions and epithelial polarity
reason: Cadherin adhesion, adherens junction assembly, apical-basal polarity and EMT regulation form one epithelial junction theme.

label: Iron, copper, manganese and heme transport
reason: Transferrin/ferroportin iron handling, heme scavenging, copper and manganese transport form one transition-metal homeostasis theme.

label: Glycerophospholipid synthesis, remodeling and transfer
reason: Synthesis of PC/PE/PS/PG/PI/CL, plasmalogens, lysophospholipid hydrolysis and intermembrane lipid transfer form one phospholipid metabolism theme; A2E/ABCA4 is PE-derived.

label: Left-right asymmetry and planar cell polarity
reason: L-R axis/Nodal and cilia items and PCP/convergent extension items are linked by Wnt-PCP orienting nodal cilia in early embryonic axis patterning; ECM-sequestering terms are odd.

label: Thymic T cell development and activation
reason: Thymocyte selection, proliferation, apoptosis, Treg development and T cell activation modules form one T lymphocyte theme.

label: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching
reason: VSMC proliferation, migration, differentiation, dedifferentiation and apoptosis in vascular remodeling are one theme.

label: DNA repair and replication stress response
reason: Interstrand cross-link/Fanconi repair, HR/BIR/SDSA, fork reversal, R-loops and genotoxic drug responses form one DNA repair theme; generic mitosis terms are minor.

label: T cell immunological synapse and polarity
reason: Immunological synapse formation, T cell polarity, Vav1/CORO1A-DEF6 cytoskeletal networks, raft localization and lymphocyte adhesion form one synapse theme.

label: Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog developmental signalling
reason: Wnt/beta-catenin destruction complex and GLI processing share GSK3/CK1/beta-TrCP machinery, and Notch, ERBB4 and p75NTR share gamma-secretase intramembrane proteolysis.

label: Eye and retina development
reason: Retinal neuron/photoreceptor differentiation, lens, cornea, iris, RPE and retinal vasculature/barrier form one eye development theme; bile duct and axis terms are minor.

label: T cell activation and differentiation
reason: T cell activation modules, TCR/costimulation and thymic differentiation dominate; NK and B items are minor.

label: Cardiac conduction system
reason: SA/AV node and His-Purkinje development, pacemaker HCN channels and conduction/depolarization regulation form one cardiac conduction theme.

label: RIG-I/MDA5-IRF3 interferon-beta induction
reason: Cytosolic RNA/DNA sensing, TBK1-IRF3/7 activation and IFN-beta/alpha production regulation form one antiviral IFN induction theme.

label: Cardiac action potential and ion channels
reason: Cardiac AP phases 0-4, K+ channels (Kv, Kir, TWIK), HCN and nodal/Purkinje depolarization form one cardiac electrophysiology theme.

label: Mitosis: chromosomes, spindle and cytokinesis
reason: Chromosome condensation, cohesion, centromere/kinetochore, spindle assembly, NE breakdown/reformation and cytokinesis form one mitotic theme.

label: Pancreatic endocrine development and insulin secretion
reason: Pancreatic progenitor/beta and alpha cell lineages, insulin processing and incretin-stimulated insulin secretion are one islet theme; adrenal is a minor odd member.

label: Fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketogenesis
reason: Carnitine shuttle, mitochondrial acyl-CoA beta-oxidation steps and ketone body synthesis/use form one fatty acid catabolism theme.

label: Systemic blood pressure and renin-angiotensin
reason: RAAS, vasopressin, endothelin, vasoconstriction/NO-cGMP and renal sodium/filtration control form one blood pressure regulation theme.

label: mRNA processing, export and RNA surveillance
reason: Splicing, 3'-end processing, export, NMD/no-go/exosome decay and ribosome-associated quality control form one RNA maturation and surveillance theme.

label: Deubiquitinases regulating NF-kB signalling
reason: DUB families, linkage-specific deubiquitination and the ubiquitin-dependent control of NF-kB/transcription factor activity form one ubiquitin-editing theme.

label: Branching morphogenesis of epithelial glands and lung
reason: Lung, mammary, salivary and prostate branching via FGF10/FGFR2b epithelial-mesenchymal signalling form one theme; ductus arteriosus and palate are minor.

label: Inflammasome and IL-1 inflammatory cytokine regulation
reason: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes, IL-1 processing, TLR regulation and IL-1/IL-6/TNF production control form one inflammatory cytokine theme.

label: Bone and tooth mineralization and remodeling
reason: Bone mineralization, osteoclast differentiation/resorption, dentin/enamel/cementum formation and FGF23-Klotho/PTH phosphate control form one mineralized tissue theme.
